---
title: "2026 Florida Primary for Governor by County and Party"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Extract the county tab-separated files to a temporary directory and read them in
pct_files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

county_party_totals <- read_tsv(
  pct_files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  col_select = c(county = X2, office = X12, party = X16, votes = X19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party %in% c("DEM", "REP")) |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, party))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 11
#| fig-width: 9

county_party_totals |>
  mutate(county = fct_reorder(county, total_votes, .fun = sum)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = county, fill = party)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("DEM" = "#eab308", "REP" = "#7e22ce"),
    labels = c("DEM" = "Democratic", "REP" = "Republican")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Primary Votes for Governor by County",
    subtitle = "Comparing Democratic and Republican primary vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Party",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

# Find the party with the most primary votes in each county
county_winner <- county_party_totals |>
  slice_max(total_votes, n = 1, by = county) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_remove_all(str_to_lower(county), "[^a-z]"))

# Join with Florida county map boundaries and plot the electoral map
map_data("county", "florida") |>
  mutate(county_key = str_remove_all(subregion, "[^a-z]")) |>
  left_join(county_winner, by = "county_key") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = party)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("DEM" = "#eab308", "REP" = "#7e22ce"),
    labels = c("DEM" = "Democratic", "REP" = "Republican")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Primary for Governor: Leading Party by County",
    subtitle = "Each county colored by the party with the highest primary vote total",
    fill = "Leading Party",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
